title: AlphaCrafter: Harnessing Multi-Agent Workflows for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading
central_strategy: Three LLM miner agents iteratively create and refine executable alpha factors, a screener evaluates and selects their factor pools, and an LLM trader consumes the selected factors and market tools to produce daily CSI 300 or S&P 500 trades under native exchange and transaction-cost rules.

attributable_repository.attribution: NJU-LINK author-organization repository with the exact paper citation, author list, and matching three-role architecture; the paper does not directly link it.

preserved_components: Native A-share buy, T+1 unlock, sell, and 2-bp commission behavior executes on controlled data.
Native U.S. short, cover, margin, and 1-bp commission behavior executes on controlled data.
The released evaluation component reproduces its total-return and maximum-drawdown contract on controlled NAVs.
required_but_missing: The paper's point-in-time S&P 500 memberships and stock, fundamental, statement, and news research snapshots.
Paper-time GPT, Claude, and Gemini requests/responses, model parameters, seeds, and ten-trial records.
The mined candidate and selected factor pools, factor values, screener decisions, and trader state.
Security-date actions, orders, fills, holdings, NAV/return arrays, brokerage records, and result generators.
Baseline implementations and the complete U.S. routing/configuration needed to identify the reported comparison.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_components_are_not_a_signal: The exchange, fee, and metric components validate accounting mechanics but produce no security score or formation-date holdings without the missing mined factors and trader decisions.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_launcher_is_not_operational: The released config requests gpt-5.3-codex while its registries contain only gpt-5 and gpt-5.2, and the launcher injects A-share instructions/tools even though U.S. components exist.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_override_probe_is_not_a_replication: A copied-tree gpt-5.2 override initialized five native agents and attempted four model requests, but received zero responses and does not match the paper's GPT/Claude/Gemini experiment protocol.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_cannot_fill_the_gap: JKP can supply the common monthly U.S. universe and accounting characteristics, but it cannot infer the unreleased generated factor pool or stateful LLM trader actions. Choosing a generic JKP factor would replace AlphaCrafter's defining workflow.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_historical_proxy_is_excluded: The older alphacrafter_full_stack_multifactor study is a researcher-authored motif translation without AlphaCrafter factor, action, or result lineage and remains secondary evidence only.

closure_rule: Do not promote component fixtures, synthetic fork display metrics, a model-substituted no-response probe, or a generic factor proxy to AlphaCrafter. Reopen for an attributable factor pool, action/holding ledger, or complete paper-result release.
